description: Measured 3D dust near the Sun (Edenhofer et al. 2024, posterior mean), resampled to a cube in the model axes of src/modules/milkyway/model.ts with the Sun at the centre. dust-cube.png: z slices as tiles, row-major, slice 0 = lowest z; grey value g gives the V-band opacity kappa = kappaMax (g / 255)^2 in 1/kpc (A_V per kpc = 1.0857 kappa). dust-column.png: the vertical optical depth through the whole map, tau = tauMax (g / 255)^2.

source.cite: Edenhofer et al. 2024, A&A 685, A82 (arXiv:2308.01295): 3D dust map out to 1.25 kpc, posterior mean
